Call the control with one JSON argument whose `summary` is the whole proposal, plus `message` (the plain history entry), `additions` (an object mapping each repository-relative path to its complete content), and `deletions` (a list of paths). Durable writes happen through it; it records the request, applies it, and prints `approved`. Write no proposal message before the call, and ask no numbered accept question.
